selection: Deterministic ledger policy: first separate validated task findings from learner hypotheses; use an observed task error to justify relevant bounded assistance without asserting its cause.
rationale: Provisional engineering limits permit context plus two prerequisite checks, one targeted instruction and one fresh verification, with one evidence-justified strategy change when budget permits. No measured information gain, probabilities, expected utility or optimal-dose claim.
assistance_rule: Delivered instructional content makes subsequent teaching-task responses assisted. Probe disclosures mark concept-specific assistance from their actual delivery onward. Unknown source assistance never becomes unassisted.
review_rule: Raw events and superseded operator annotations remain append-only. Recompute effective evidence in temporal assistance partitions; pending categorization does not consume prompts.
